verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs such as llms.txt are a fair question for a SaaS HR and payroll platform, so the axis applies. The probe found llms.txt returns HTTP 404 on the help center, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any candidate path. The docs evidence is ordinary help-center content about payroll, benefits, PTO and Xero, and says nothing about agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
